title: Passing

vibeProfile.oneLine: Two Black friends reunite in 1920s New York, one of them passing as white.

summary: Two light-skinned Black women, childhood friends, meet again as adults in 1920s New York: one lives openly in Harlem, the other has been 'passing' as white, married to a bigoted husband who has no idea. Their renewed, charged friendship pulls both toward danger. Nella Larsen's short, taut novel of the Harlem Renaissance is a coolly brilliant study of race, class and identity as performance, and its ambiguous, shocking ending has kept readers arguing for nearly a century.
whyReadIt: A taut, brilliant Harlem Renaissance novel about race as performance. Short, sharp, and it ends on a jolt.

funFacts.text: Long under-read, it has become a central text of the Harlem Renaissance and was recently filmed.
